name: Ad-Hoc 2035 Strategic Plan Committee Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
AGENDA
  Meeting of the City Council's
  AD-HOC 2035 STRATEGIC PLAN COMMITTEE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Hall - Large Community Room
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  MONDAY, JUNE 23, 2025 – 4:00 p.m.
  .

To provide Public Comments, you may attend in-person at City Hall or submit your written
comments via email to the City Clerk's Office (cityclerk@wlv.org) no later than 11:00 a.m. on the
meeting date. Written comments will be provided to the Strategic Plan Committee Members
prior to the meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-Committee-Supplemental-Packets

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

 Agenda are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas or
 www.wlv.org/agendacenter

 If any additional disclosable public records are distributed to the Committee Members less
 than 72 hours prior to the meeting, such materials are available in City Hall during normal
 business hours and are posted on the City’s Website -https://www.wlv.org/611/Council-
 Committee-Supplemental-Packets

 Signup for Agenda Posting Notifications for the Agenda Center. The Agenda Center is a
 central location for all public meeting agendas. You select the categories for your
 notifications.  Sign up using “Notify Me” on the Westlake Village home page or
 https://www.wlv.org/List.aspx
 CALL TO ORDER  4:00 p.m.

ROLL CALL:  Mayor Honig and Councilmember Pearl

  Members of the 2035 Strategic Plan Committee:

  Ted Corwin, Lara Evangelista, Lindsay Iwanoff, Curt Knabe,
  Chad Martinson, Tish Matthews, Tom Sutphen, Mark
  Teitelbaum, TJ Tramonto, Rick Winters

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the Strategic Plan Committee on items not on the printed agenda
and within the Council’s/Committee’s subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit of three
minutes.

BUSINESS:

1.  Review of the First Ad-Hoc 2035 Strategic Plan Committee Meeting – Staff to
  provide an overview of the first Ad-Hoc 2035 Strategic Plan Committee Meeting.

2.  Discussion of the 2025 Strategic Plan Values – Committee to discuss and
  provide input on the values listed in the 2025 Strategic Plan.

3.  Overview and Discussion of the 2025 Strategic Plan Goals and
  Accomplishments – Staff to provide an overview of the 2025 Strategic Plan Goals
  and resulting accomplishments with feedback and discussion from the Committee.

4.  Meeting Wrap-Up and Review of Agenda for Meeting Three – Committee and
  staff to debrief on the second meeting and staff to provide a tentative agenda for
  the third meeting.

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Friday, June 20, 2025 at 8:30 a.m. on the City’s website and in the
Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  June 20, 2025
